vsa.narrative: Context now: uptrend (rising 50-day, +106% in 20 bars); background: bag holding 18 Sep and buying climax 25 Sep; a no-demand bar 22 Jul on volume 58% below average - no demand in a downtrend: significant (moderate significance); selling climax 11 Aug on 3.3x volume, closed in the upper half - (then: downtrend) after a decline: panic supply absorbed by professional buying, at support / new lows (high significance); selling climax 12 Aug on 18.0x volume, closed on the low - (then: downtrend) climactic selling with strength already appearing: accumulation, at support / new lows (high significance); two no-supply bars 31 Aug–3 Sep on volume 82% below average - (then: downtrend) no selling pressure after climactic strength: background has changed (moderate significance); a test 16 Sep on volume 74% below average - (then: downtrend) a test after climactic strength: the background has changed (moderate significance); buying climax 25 Sep on 4.9x volume, closed off the lows - after a run: the crowd buys from professionals - start of distribution, at resistance / new highs (high significance); latest: no supply 8 Oct on 0.1x volume, closed on the low - but no selling pressure, but weakness in the background (low significance); latest: test in a rising market 9 Oct on 0.1x volume, closed on the low - a test in a rising market, but with weakness in the background (low significance: marginal bar) (awaiting next bar); balance strength 89/100.

vsa_seq.lens: Williams lens (a tribute to Tom Williams's method): Background first: GLND is in an uptrend, the VSA balance reads strength (89/100), last key bar TR on 9 Oct. Holmes strength sequence S5 (two-bar reversal → test / no supply → no supply) completed 2 Oct: bottom / two-bar reversal 4 Sep → no supply / test 29 Sep → no supply 2 Oct. It confirms on a trade above 4.34; a close below 1.09 proves it wrong (expired untriggered). Desk backtest for S5: noise (+0.06R over 3562 trades). Holmes strength sequence S3 (bottom reversal → test → no supply / test) completed 29 Sep: bottom / two-bar reversal 4 Sep → test 16 Sep → no supply / test 29 Sep. It confirms on a trade above 5.02; a close below 1.09 proves it wrong (triggered). Desk backtest for S3: noise (+0.07R over 1796 trades).
